title: Panoramod
description: Adds a /panoramod command to take a panoramic screenshot split into 6 files in the resource pack filename format, with variable panorama sizes.
body:
# What does this do?
This mod adds a panoramic screenshot feature which produces 6 files for each face of a cube. 

# How does it output?
The filename format is directly compatible with resource packs (as in `panorama_X.png` where X is a number from 0-5).

# Can I modify the size?
Yes, pass it as an argument to the `/panoramod` command. Default is 1024, **sizes above 2000 may cause lag/high resource usage.**
